cues.text: I studied mass communication, and for more than three years I've been turning complicated crypto and AI products into stories people actually understand.
This is my work. Hackathon demos, product explainers, launch videos and series. Every number checked, every claim true.
Lately, almost everything I cover involves AI agents. Agents that hold wallets, read your posts, and act on your behalf.
So when I built my own agent, Strike Agent, a paper trading bot on X, safety came first. Strict commands instead of guesswork, verified events, and only you can touch your own positions.
That's why Armor IQ stood out to me. Every tool call an agent makes, planned, policy checked, and auditable. That's the layer builders in my community are missing.
In my first ninety days, I'd explain Armor IQ in videos and threads, build an open source demo with it, and host a live session on securing your agent before you ship it.
I'm Yezir Hasan. Let's make agents people can trust.
